text:
pem_dtos
Description
This command is used the TAC (Type Allocation Code) DB. This is
available from most of the rule events. It takes the IMEI/IMEISV as
the input. The input could be a URL string or an IPV4 address. IPV6
addresses are not currently supported. iRule returns the URL
categories returned by the urlcat library.
Syntax
pem_dtos
tac
lookup
<
IMEI
>
urlcatquery
Query the TAC DB for IMEI Details
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.info
"This is the lookup [pem_dtos tac lookup 012430000000132]”      <<<< Just log a query on a specific IMEI. IMEI can be retrieved from PEM session as well.
}
